voiceSummary: HDFC Bank Limited reports that the Special Resolution for the re-appointment of Mrs. Lily Vadera, DIN 09400410, as an Independent Director has been passed with the requisite majority. The resolution was approved via postal ballot on Friday, November 20, 2026. Scrutinizer Mr. B. Narasimhan of M/s. BN & Associates confirmed the results. Out of 48,41,772 members holding shares as of the cut-off date of Friday, October 16, 2026, 12,114 members voted. The votes in favor accounted for 99.092 percent of valid votes cast, while votes against accounted for 0.908 percent. The e-voting period ran from Thursday, October 22, 2026, to Friday, November 20, 2026. The results are deemed passed on the last date of the e-voting period.

attchmntText: HDFC Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Grant of stock options under Employee Stock Option Scheme (ESOS   Plan H-2024) and Grant of Restricted Stock Units under Employees  Stock Incentive Master Scheme   2022'.
voiceSummary: HDFC Bank granted 1,86,031 equity stock options under ESOS Plan H-2024 at Rs. 816.50 per option. These options vest in four equal stages over forty-eight months and must be exercised within four years of vesting. The bank also granted 41,377 restricted stock units under RSU 021 at Re. 1 per unit. These units vest in four equal stages over forty-eight months and must be exercised within one year of vesting. The grants were approved by the Governance, Nomination and Remuneration Committee on November 17, 2026.

attchmntText: HDFC Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 1412278  Shares.
voiceSummary: HDFC Bank allotted 14,12,278 equity shares to employees on November 17, 2026, pursuant to the exercise of options and restricted stock units under its Employees Stock Options Schemes and Employee Stock Incentive Scheme. Consequently, the bank's paid-up share capital increased from 15,43,24,11,468 equity shares of Re. 1 each to 15,43,38,23,746 equity shares of Re. 1 each. The company secretary, Ajay Agarwal, submitted this information to the BSE and NSE for their records.
